correctness.rationale: The specified C1 two-piece quadratic spline has dimension six and interpolation equations at 0, epsilon, 1, R and two matching conditions at (1+epsilon)/2. Recomputing the exact 6x6 determinant gives epsilon(R-1)(epsilon-1)[-R epsilon-3R+epsilon^2+2epsilon+1]/4, nonzero on 0<epsilon<1<R. Divide the colliding interpolation difference by epsilon, pass to the invertible confluent matrix and obtain the operator-norm limit epsilon I_epsilon -> (y2-y1) g_R with left quadratic t-(4R-1)t^2/(3R-1) and right quadratic (t-1)(t-R)/(3R-1). Its two competing absolute extrema occur at (3R-1)/(2(4R-1)) and (R+1)/2. Their heights give the stated sharp norm coefficient and cross uniquely at R=2+sqrt(3). Uniform convergence of all four Lagrange basis functions gives uniform convergence of Lebesgue functions and correct maximizer localization, including the two-point tie. Independent symbolic determinant and exact rational R=3/2,2,4,6 checks corroborate the algebra. This is fixed-R, epsilon->0 only; no uniform-in-R inference.
